lines.en: Long ago I had an important job.
Really, Grandma? What was your job then?
I was a chef at a restaurant for ten years.
Wow! And what did Grandpa do?
He was a bus driver in those days.
Was the owner of the restaurant kind?
Yes. The owner was kind to every worker then.
lines.ko: 네. 그때 주인은 모든 일꾼에게 친절했어요.

lines.en: I want to hear more stories!
I will tell you more after dinner.
Thank you, Grandma. You are still a great chef!
lines.ko: 고마워요, 할머니. 할머니는 지금도 훌륭한 요리사예요!

lines.en: What do you want to be when you grow up?
I want to be an artist, Grandma.
An artist! You drew a beautiful picture last week.
Thank you. My friends want to be engineers and lawyers.
lines.ko: 고마워요. 제 친구들은 기술자와 변호사가 되고 싶어 해요.

lines.en: That's an important job too. What about a writer?
Maybe. A writer makes stories. Is that hard?
lines.ko: 글쎄요. 작가는 이야기를 만들어요. 그게 어려워요?

lines.en: Every job is hard, but you will learn.
lines.ko: 모든 직업이 어렵지만, 배우게 될 거예요.

lines.en: Will you come to my first art show?
lines.ko: 제 첫 전시회에 와 줄 거예요?

lines.en: Of course. I will be the first one there.
Then I will paint a picture of you, Grandma!
